card.name: Patent wording about development effort
card.fires_on: Small linking words and commas inside the stock patent sentence about actual implementations, such as 'must be made' and 'time-consuming, but would nevertheless be a routine undertaking'. It also fires weakly on 'but' or 'to' in contrast clauses elsewhere.

modes.label: Patent implementation boilerplate
modes.description: Function words and punctuation inside the stock sentence about implementation-specific decisions and routine development effort.
